topics: reasons for studying in the UK
Educational background and connection to current plans
Post-graduation career goals and degree relevance
quotes: Why you chose this specific course
What you like about the module choices
Why the city of Stirling is a good place for you to live
Your past studies and how it connects to your chosen plan
Cost of living and how you'll afford to pay for food, bills etc
sources.notes: 'A Pre-CAS interview is conducted on CAS Shield and is a means to ensure that you have seriously considered your study choices. The interview will be a series of randomised questions about your course and university as well as your background and reasons for studying in the UK.' Approx 20 minutes, reviewed by admissions staff; staff recommendation determines whether a CAS is issued. Don'ts: 'Use AI. AI use is easier to detect than you think', 'Read from scripts'. Quotes are topic prompts, not literal questions; CAS Shield randomises from themed banks so no fixed list exists.
